promptEn: A high-octane cinematic sci-fi action sequence set on a destroyed, smoke-filled highway under an overcast, moody sky. An athletic woman with curly dark hair wearing an olive green tank top and dark tactical pants rides a matte-black futuristic motorcycle with dual front heavy tires and glowing white LED headlights through chaotic traffic, avoiding burning car wrecks and fiery explosions. Dual heavy plasma gatling guns deploy from the motorcycle chassis with mechanical precision, firing upward at a massive hovering triangular alien mothership until it explodes in a brilliant fireball above the road. The motorcycle launches off a concrete barrier ramp into a dramatic mid-air slow-motion leap against light rays, exploding upon impact as the rider alights and lands gracefully in a three-point superhero landing on the asphalt surrounded by flames. She stands up and sprints at superhuman speed her futuristic cybernetic leg armor featuring glowing blue LED line accents towards a blonde female opponent in a black leather jacket. She engages in fast-paced martial arts hand-to-hand combat, delivering a powerful kinetic kick that sends the opponent flying into an overturned truck that detonates in a massive fire explosion. Hyper-realistic live-action movie aesthetic, 8k resolution, cinematic lighting, volumetric light shafts, explosive FX, low-angle tracking shot, fast action pacing, dynamic motion blur, shot on 35mm lens.
